items.title: Vanishing of the etale cohomology of the multiplicative group over a function field of a curve
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the etale cohomology of the multiplicative group over a field of transcendence degree one over an algebraically closed field vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 10906-10911). The proof translates the assertion into the vanishing of Brauer groups of finite extensions (proof lines 10913-10918) and then reduces to finitely generated extensions of transcendence degree one by writing the extension as a filtered colimit and using that Brauer groups commute with such colimits (proof lines 10919-10927), where the vanishing is the corresponding result for function fields of curves. The non-formal content is the colimit reduction. The claim is H2: two reductions, both written out.
